name: Sneaky Splash
body:
Even your splash weapons are precise enough to cause precise damage.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemy class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you land a direct hit with a splash weapon (but not bombs from the bomb class feature), your attack can deal precision damage against the creature your attack landed against (but not dealt splash damage) if it would normally qualify for it, such as by attacking an unaware creature while possessing the sneak attack class feature. This precision damage deals the same type of damage as the splash weapon.

Normal: You cannot deal precision damage with ranged touch attacks.
